retracted_diagnosis: Binary FLOAT parameters were initially blamed for the 29-row discrepancy. Controlled reproduction with and without UTC disproved that diagnosis.
confirmed_cause: The semantic smoke explicitly set DuckDB TimeZone to UTC, but the formal timing runner omitted that setting. On this machine DuckDB inherited Asia/Shanghai, so CAST(DATE AS TIMESTAMPTZ) shifted the Q6 date boundary relative to UTC parameters.

required_fix: Make UTC an explicit validated timing-protocol field, record it in environment.json, set it before creating the trusted view, and repeat semantic preflight before any future timing.
